body: WITHDRAWN (6 Nov 2026, evening): my earlier note proposed moving right-to-left before gate 1. The owner then said not to worry about interface languages now: the app stays English as long as Arabic MUSIC plays and is told apart (that is P2-25, unchanged). Nothing moves; this item stays where it is. If an Arabic-speaking friend later needs the screens in Arabic, the measured fact stands: an app set to Arabic stays English and left-to-right today.
